findings.explanation: Waiting 90 days for payment creates a significant cash flow delay for your business.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a small adjustment before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, waiting 90 days for payment creates a significant cash flow delay, so I propose modifying the text to state that invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt. Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to working together.
